summary.en: “Tim Cook is the former CEO of Apple” is confirmed by dogrulukpayi.com and apple.com. “Tim Cook came to Istanbul” is confirmed by dogrulukpayi.com and gazeteoksijen.com. “Tim Cook stated that Apple became the world's richest company by selling the iPhone it manufactures for $700…” is contradicted by dogrulukpayi.com. “Tim Cook stated that Turks pay $4,000 for an iPhone, are a nation richer than Apple, and that he came to see…” is contradicted by dogrulukpayi.com. While former Apple CEO Tim Cook did visit Istanbul, the quotes attributed to him regarding iPhone production costs and Turkish consumers paying $4,000 are entirely fabricated. A fact-check by Doğruluk Payı confirms he never made these statements. The image accompanying the post has also been digitally altered.

description.en: A man wearing glasses and a navy blue suit stands in front of a white background featuring a large football sculpture and an Apple logo. He is smiling with his hands clasped in front of him.

authenticity.rationale: The photograph displays natural lighting, consistent reflections, sharp fine details, and no signs of AI generation or digital manipulation.

differences.what: An Apple logo has been digitally added above the giant football sculpture in the first image.
The second image has Turkish text added above the photo within a social media post interface format, and the photo itself is slightly cropped at the sides.
An Apple logo has been added above Tim Cook's head.
The first image has a wider vertical framing showing Tim Cook down to his hands, whereas the second image is cropped closely around his chest.

summary.en: The image has been digitally altered by adding an Apple logo above the football sculpture and inserting Turkish text. The original photo appeared online in September 2026.
